text: Jordan Vance presents the finished knowledge assistant to Priya Desai, Omar Haddad, and Wrenfield's leadership -- three real weeks of employee use, across HR, IT, and Ops.
The number comes first: hundreds of real questions answered, every answer citing an actual document, and a real 'I don't know' when nothing supports an answer.
Then the harder part, told plainly: a stale draft wiki page tried to hijack the AI into telling real VPN questions to call extension 4421 instead.
Lena Ortiz's red-team review caught it -- a test question traced through the logs to one leftover file -- before any real employee ever saw that answer.
Real adoption, and a real incident the review caught and fixed before launch. Next: what the assistant actually does for Priya's and Omar's teams, day to day.
